title: Longest Run

story.briefing: A stuck transmitter repeats one character until it clears. The longest stretch of repetition tells the engineers how bad the fault was.
story.success: Fault duration measured. The transmitter is scheduled for replacement.

description: Given a string, return the length of the longest run of identical characters appearing consecutively. An empty string returns 0.

examples.explanation: The run of three b characters.

hints: You only ever need to know how long the current run is and how long the best run so far was.
The final run ends when the string ends, not when a different character appears. Code that only updates the best on a change will miss a run that reaches the last character.
Walk the string keeping a current-run counter. Reset it to 1 when the character differs from the previous one, otherwise increment it, and update the best after every step.
